import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
sub = df[df.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()
# find all rows on 10-20 whose price or num_instances differs from that group's pre-anomaly values
pre = sub[sub.date < '2025-10-20']
base_price = pre.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['price'].agg(['mean','min','max','nunique'])
base_n = pre.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['num_instances'].agg(['mean','min','max'])
anom = sub[sub.date >= '2025-10-20'].merge(base_price, on=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'], how='left').merge(base_n, on=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'], how='left', suffixes=('_p','_n'))
chg = anom[(anom.price > anom.max_p) | (anom.num_instances > anom.max_n)]
print(chg[['date','cloud_service','application','instance_family','price','num_instances','mean_p','max_p','mean_n','max_n','unblended_cost']].drop_duplicates(subset=['cloud_service','application','instance_family']).to_string())

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
sub = df[df.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()
pre = sub[sub.date < '2025-10-20']
base = pre.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(max_n=('num_instances','max'), max_p=('price','max'))
day = sub[sub.date=='2025-10-20'].merge(base, on=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])
day['contrib'] = day.unblended_cost - day.max_n*day.max_p  # rough
# better: decompose
day['delta_vs_typical'] = day.unblended_cost - (pre.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].mean().values)
grp = day.set_index(['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])
anom = grp[(grp.num_instances>grp.max_n)|(grp.price>grp.max_p)]
anom = anom.assign(cost_delta = anom.unblended_cost - anom.max_n*anom.max_p)
print(anom[['date','price','num_instances','max_p','max_n','unblended_cost','cost_delta']].sort_values('cost_delta',ascending=False).to_string())
